title: Difficult to determine correct settings.
text: Difficult to determine correct settings.. Difficult to determine correct settings. The 8 presets didn't match anything I wanted to cook. If you need to open to turn the food it resets the temp and time and you have to re-enter. I only found 7 items that I would regularly cook and they were all frozen. I use it mostly for frozen steak fries and frozen biscuit dough. If I bought another one I wouldn't get the digital model. Buy the less expensive rotary dial model.

product_metadata.title: GoWISE USA 3.7-Quart Programmable 8-in-1 Air Fryer, GW22611
features: Air Fry your favorite foods with little to no oil. The rapid air technology lets you air fry your favorite fried foods with little to no oil. Create healthier versions of your favorite foods with this Gowise USA air fryer.
3.7 QT capacity. This size is perfect for families with 2 - 4 people.

This air fryer comes with 8 presets designed to help make your life a little easier. 8 cooking presets: Warm-Up, Chips, Chicken, Steak, Meat, Cake, and Fish. Healthy and Easy way to fry food; Uses Rapid Air Circulation
If you'd rather set your own time and temperature, don't worry we have functions for that. Cooking timer up to 30 Minutes; temperature control from 180F - 400F.
Includes Recipe Book, which is filled with 50 recipes made specifically for (and with) the GoWISE USA air fryer. Recipes are for breakfast, lunch, dinner, and dessert.
description: This GoWISE USA Electric Air Fryer is a new, healthy and easy way to fry food. It uses a Rapid Air Circulating System to cook food. It works by circulating hot air in all directions around the ingredients. This Air Fryer gives you the option of frying, grilling, roasting, or baking your favorite foods. You can prepare anything from cakes to crispy French fries. It comes with a removable pan with a cool-to-touch handgrip and detachable basket to make it easy to transfer food from the fryer to a serving dish. They are also dishwasher safe. This Electric Air Fryer features temperature control from 176⁰F - 392⁰F, a cooking timer up to 30 minutes, and 8 different cooking pre-sets : "Warm-Up", "Chips", "Chicken", "Steak", "Shrimp", "Meat", "Cake", & "Fish". Safety features include overheat protection, automatic switch off, and automatic standby mode. The GoWISE USA Air Fryer is ETL certified and complies with all standards regarding Electro-Magnetic fields. If you have any questions regarding the Air Fryer and it's operation, contact the GoWISE USA customer service.
